instruction: Set up a Ceph dashboard with SSL
output: ceph mgr module enable dashboard && ceph dashboard set-ssl-certificate -i /path/to/cert.pem
ceph dashboard ac-user-create myuser mypassword administrator

instruction: Enable the Ceph REST API module
Set the Ceph MGR standby count

output: ceph balancer mode upmap && ceph balancer on
gluster volume create hot-tier replica 2 gluster-node1:/fast gluster-node2:/fast && gluster volume create cold-tier replica 2 gluster-node3:/slow gluster-node4:/slow

instruction: Attach a tier to a GlusterFS volume
output: gluster volume tier hot-tier attach cold-tier
gluster volume create gvol1 disperse 6 redundancy 2 gluster-node[1-6]:/bricks
gluster volume set gvol1 nfs-ganesha enable

instruction: Disable GlusterFS NFS server (use NFS-Ganesha instead)
output: gluster volume set gvol1 nfs.disable on
gluster volume set gvol1 performance.strict-o-direct on
gluster volume set gvol1 performance.readdirp off

instruction: Set GlusterFS quick-read for small files
output: gluster volume set gvol1 performance.quick-read on

instruction: Enable GlusterFS eager-lock for NFS workloads
output: gluster volume set gvol1 network.eager-lock on

instruction: Enable GlusterFS quota on existing volume
Set GlusterFS default soft quota timeout
Set GlusterFS hard timeout for quota
